info.name: Mux Cloud
info.description: Mux Cloud REST API: accounts, machines, the relay to your mux machines, billing, tickets, admin, and request history. Every value that differs by environment is a collection variable. Run "Login (mobile)" first; its test script stores the tokens that every authenticated request sends as a bearer token. Browsers use HttpOnly cookies instead (client "web"). Full reference: REST_API.md and WEBSOCKETS_API.md in https://github.com/jchristn/MuxCloud.

request.description: Returns status, product, version, and server time. Used by Docker healthchecks.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign up, verify, sign in, refresh, sign out, and password reset. Login with client "mobile" returns tokens in the body (saved to collection variables by the test script); client "web" sets HttpOnly cookies instead.

request.description: Create a user with a personal account and tenant. A verification email is sent. 409 EmailInUse when the address is taken.
Confirm an email with the token from the verification link (evf_...). Single use, 48 hours.
Always 202, so it reveals nothing about the address.
Sign in and receive access and refresh tokens in the body. The test script stores them.
Sign in as the seed administrator for the Admin folder.
Rotate the refresh token. Replaying an old refresh token revokes the session.

Set a new password with the pwr_ token. Revokes every session.

Delete the account, revoke every machine, and close their tunnels.

item.name: Machines
item.description: Enroll and manage machines. Enrollment takes the account credentials and returns a machine secret once; mux stores it and discards the password.

request.description: Returns machineId and machineSecret (shown once). 402 EntitlementExceeded when machines.max is reached; re-enrolling the same fingerprint rotates the secret.
Online machines first, then most recently seen.

The machine sees the new name on its next welcome.
Invalidate the secret and close the tunnel with 4403.
Tunnel connection history, newest first.
Revoke and delete with history.

item.name: Relay
item.description: Requests to /m/{machineId}/... go through the machine tunnel to its local mux API, unchanged. 503 MachineOffline when the machine is not connected.

request.description: mux health on the machine.
The machine's conversations.
The machine's own mux dashboard, rendered to call back through the relay.
Server-sent events stream through as they are produced.

item.name: Tickets
item.description: Single-use WebSocket tickets for bearer clients.

request.description: Valid for 30 seconds. Use as ?ticket= on /v1.0/events or /m/{machineId}/v1.0/ws.

item.name: Devices
item.description: Push devices for the mobile app, scoped to the signed-in user. Notifications for approval_requested and run_completed machine status pushes carry the machine name, a generic phrase, and deep-link identifiers only.

request.description: Register an Expo push token. 201 for a new device, 200 with the existing device when the token is already registered. The token is never returned.
The user's devices, newest first, without tokens.
Remove a device. 404 for another user's device.
